description: Enable strict: true in tsconfig and never disable flags per file
rationale: Strict mode is where most of TypeScript's safety lives

description: Avoid the any type — use unknown with narrowing instead
rationale: any opts out of type checking and defeats the purpose of TS

description: Do not use @ts-ignore — use @ts-expect-error with a linked issue
Declare explicit return types on exported functions
rationale: Inferred returns can change silently with implementation edits

description: Type external JSON as unknown and validate with a schema
rationale: Trusting external shapes as typed is a common source of runtime bugs

description: Model variants as discriminated unions with a literal kind field
rationale: Discriminated unions give exhaustive checking in switch statements

description: Mark props and config objects as readonly
rationale: Readonly prevents accidental mutation of shared state

description: Use 'as const' on literal arrays and objects for narrow types
rationale: Const assertions preserve literal types through inference

description: Avoid the ! non-null assertion — prove non-null via narrowing
rationale: Non-null assertions defer errors to runtime

description: Use type for unions and mapped types, interface for object contracts
rationale: Each has strengths; pick per use case, not dogma

description: Use Zod or Valibot at API/FS/CLI boundaries — infer static types from schemas
rationale: Single source of truth for runtime + compile-time types

description: Use a never assertion in default to force exhaustive handling
rationale: Compiler catches missing cases when the union grows

description: Prefer 'as const' object or string union over TS enum
rationale: TS enums have surprising runtime semantics and hurt tree-shaking
